column1: Bobby Witt Jr. stands out as the top pick, offering strong reliability with hits in nearly 75% of games and a favorable platoon edge against Parker Messick. Yandy Diaz is another steady option, leading off for Tampa Bay and consistently reaching base in a high-contact lineup spot. CJ Abrams and Trea Turner both benefit from advantageous matchups but have shown less recent consistency, making Witt and Diaz the safest choices for Beat The Streak players today.
